brand.name: Anahom Stays
brand.personality: Calm, Grounded, Thoughtful, Honest, Warm, Intentional, Quiet Confidence, Human, Timeless, Architectural, Natural.
brand.anti_patterns: Corporate, loud, startup-like, salesy, AI-sounding, bright colors, gradients, default vercel/stripe look.
brand.references: Apple, Aman Resorts, Aesop, Kinfolk, Airbnb Luxe.

art_direction.concept: A scroll-driven storytelling experience (scrollytelling) that feels like reading a beautifully designed, timeless coffee-table book. Every scroll reveals a new chapter with meaningful motion and subtle interactions.
art_direction.aesthetic: Luxury is restraint. Editorial layout, large margins, beautiful rhythm, muted earthy palette, cinematic imagery, and sophisticated typography.

colors.description: A natural, warm, and earthy palette avoiding stark whites or pure blacks. No bright colors or generic gradients.

warm_white.usage: Primary background for the entire page to give a soft, natural paper feel.

travertine.usage: Secondary background, surface layers, and subtle section dividers.

sand.usage: Soft accents, borders, or muted highlight backgrounds.

stone.usage: Secondary text, muted borders, inactive states.

muted_olive.usage: Primary brand accent for key interaction points, quiet highlights, or secondary buttons.

bronze.usage: Warm interactive highlights or subtle call-to-action details.

natural_charcoal.usage: Primary text color, deep dark backgrounds for high-contrast inverted sections. Never use pure black (#000000).

typography.description: An unexpected but fitting editorial font pairing that avoids overused fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.

primary.usage: All headlines, large quotes, numbers, and the Founders' letter. Elegant, high-contrast, editorial.

secondary.usage: Body copy, captions, UI labels, small navigation links. Clean, modern, highly legible.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-none text-natural_charcoal
rules.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight text-natural_charcoal
rules.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-sans tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-stone
rules.letter_spacing: Always use tracking-tight for large serif headlines. Use wide tracking for overlines.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical web design.
layout_and_spacing.container: Max-width screen-2xl mx-auto, but rely heavily on editorial asymmetric grids.
layout_and_spacing.margins: Massive margins. Use px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24. Section padding should be py-24 md:py-32 lg:py-48.
layout_and_spacing.grid: Bento Grid Protocol Mode A (Tetris/Asymmetry). Avoid generic 2-column or 3-column equal grids. Let text breathe in a 4-col span while images take 8-col spans.

motion_and_interactions.scrollytelling_core: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling is MANDATORY. Standard browser scroll will ruin the luxury feel.

animations.text_reveal: Masked line-by-line slide-up reveal. Use Framer Motion to animate text from y: 100% with a clip-path or overflow-hidden wrapper. Stagger the lines.
animations.image_parallax: Images must scale slightly (1.05 to 1.0) or shift softly on scroll using useScroll and useTransform.
animations.clipped_frames: Images should have an initial clipped aspect ratio (e.g., 3:4) that subtly expands or reveals more of the photo as the user scrolls into the section.
animations.marquee: Extremely slow, elegant editorial marquee using Serif font. No standard fast-moving tickers.
animations.micro_interactions: Buttons 'breathe' (soft scale). Objects react softly to cursor. Hospitality begins with interaction.

1_hero.description: Cinematic fullscreen hero. Cinematic video/image background. Autoplay silent, loop.
1_hero.overlay: bg-natural_charcoal/30. Ensure it does not kill the image, just makes text readable.
1_hero.content: Massive masked line-by-line headline reveal. A 'Scroll to begin' vertical subtle line indicator.

2_philosophy.description: Numbered manifesto chapters. Warm white background. Oversized serif numbers (01, 02). Staggered text reveals as the user scrolls.

3_our_story.description: Narrative reveal. Travertine background. Side-by-side or overlapping asymmetric images. Parallax effects on the photos.

4_homes_we_love.description: Interactive photography gallery. Clipped frames and spotlight hover effects. Let the architectural photography be the hero.

5_why_choose_anahom.description: Interactive icons or subtle comparison. Use muted olive accents. Clean, restrained, architectural structure.

6_partnership_models.description: Elegant interactive comparison slider instead of generic SaaS pricing cards. Use bronze and stone colors to differentiate.

7_our_process.description: Animated abstract house-illustration or step reveal. Each step lights up or draws itself via SVG path animation on scroll.

8_founders_letter.description: Handwritten-letter feel. Travertine or Sand background. Deep natural charcoal serif typography. Signature animates on load/scroll.

9_faqs.description: Expandable minimal accordion. 1px stone color borders. No boxes, just elegant typography lines.

10_contact.description: WhatsApp/Call/Email links + simple restrained form. Ends with a slow editorial marquee.

mobile_first_specifics.touch: Premium, thumb-friendly tap targets. Smooth native-feeling interactions.
mobile_first_specifics.layout: Do not cram content. Stack elements elegantly with ample py-16 padding. Prevent images from dominating the full screen height (max 70vh) so text is always in context.
mobile_first_specifics.performance: Ensure Framer Motion animations do not cause jank on mobile. Use lightweight variants if necessary.

hero_cinematic.description: Modern, luxurious house sits among palm trees. Sunlight.

philosophy_texture.description: White textured plaster/travertine surface for organic background.

homes_we_love_2.description: Modern minimalist architectural interior with strong shadows.

our_story_lifestyle.description: Low angle palm trees in soft morning light.

component_instructions.ui_library: Use Shadcn/UI for complex functional elements (accordion, form inputs) but strip all default Vercel-like styling. Remove borders, rounded corners, and harsh shadows. Make them look editorial.
component_instructions.custom_components: Build structural layouts (Hero, Marquee, Gallery) using raw HTML/Tailwind and Framer Motion.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
NEVER use dark colors as gradients.
NEVER center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
ALWAYS create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
ALWAYS use micro-animations on hover states, transitions, parallax, and entrance.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
Avoid using emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) as icons. Use Lucide, Phosphor, or Heroicons.
Always rely on the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text for images.
